DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: こんにちは。体験で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Hello. Is there a problem with the activity?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 粘土体験が終わりましたが、子どもの袖と借りた前掛けが汚れました。返す前掛けはどこへ置けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 粘土で汚れた貸出前掛けの返却場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.translation: We've finished the clay workshop, but my child's sleeves and the borrowed apron got dirty. Where should I put the apron to return it?
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask where to return the borrowed apron dirtied with clay. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 汚れた前掛けはこちらの返却かごへお願いします。ご自分の服は、ここでは洗えませんが袋をご用意できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Please put the dirty apron in this return basket. You can't wash your own clothes here, but we can provide a bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 着替えはあります。汚れた服を入れる袋を一つお願いします。前掛けは返却かごへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 着替え後の汚れた私服用袋を依頼し前掛けを返却すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.translation: We have a change of clothes. One bag for the dirty clothes, please. I'll put the apron in the return basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Request a bag for the dirty personal clothes after changing and say that you will return the apron. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: どうぞ。作品はまだ柔らかいので、二つを重ねないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Here you are. The pieces are still soft, so please don't stack the two together.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 同じ箱へ入れようとしていました。親子の作品を別々の台紙に載せて運びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 柔らかい親子の作品を別の台紙に載せたいと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.translation: I was about to put them in the same box. I'd like to carry my child's piece and mine on separate backing boards.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask to place the parent's and child's soft pieces on separate backing boards. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 台紙を二枚使えます。作品に触れず、台紙の端を持ってお運びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.translation: You can use two boards. Please carry them by the edges without touching the pieces.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 私が二枚を運び、子どもには軽い荷物だけ持ってもらいます。家まで電車なので箱にも入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 大人が作品を運び子どもは軽い荷物担当にし電車用の箱も求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll carry both boards and have my child carry only light belongings. We're going home by train, so I'd also like boxes.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say that the adult will carry the pieces and the child light belongings, and request boxes for the train. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 箱は二つあります。台紙を入れた後も作品同士が触れないよう、別々の箱でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.translation: We have two boxes. Use separate boxes so the pieces don't touch each other even after putting the boards in.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 前掛けを返しました。作品は一つずつ台紙と箱へ入れ、汚れた服の袋とは分けて運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 前掛けを返し作品二つと私服を別々に運ぶと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.translation: I've returned the apron. I'll put each piece on a board in its own box and carry them separately from the dirty-clothes bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm returning the apron and carrying the two pieces separately from your clothes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。作品を楽しんでください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Enjoy your creations. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 昨日買った収納箱の取手が、荷物を運んでいる途中で外れました。商品を見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 購入箱の取手が運搬中に外れたため商品確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.translation: The handle of the storage box I bought yesterday came off while I was carrying things. I'd like you to look at the product.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask for the purchased box to be checked because the handle came off during transport. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: お品物とレシートを拝見します。中には何を入れていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Let me see the product and receipt. What did you have inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 本を入れていました。未使用ではありませんし、何キロだったかは量っていないのでわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 本を入れた使用済み商品で重量は未測定と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Books. It isn't unused, and I don't know how many kilograms it weighed because I didn't weigh it.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Explain that the product has been used to carry books and the weight was not measured. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: わかりました。使用した状態も含めて確認します。外れた部品は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.translation: I see. We'll check it, including how it was used. Do you still have the parts that came off?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 取手と小さい部品を持ってきました。落ちた直後の写真もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 外れた部品と直後写真を持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.translation: I brought the handle and small parts. I also have a photo taken just after it fell.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say that you brought the detached parts and a photo from immediately afterward. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 部品と写真も確認します。交換やほかの対応ができるかは、商品の状態を見てからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.translation: We'll check the parts and photo too. We'll explain whether exchange or another response is possible after seeing the product's condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: お願いします。新しい商品を先に持ち帰るのではなく、確認結果を聞いてから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 確認結果が出るまで交換品を持ち帰らず対応を決めたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Thank you. Rather than take a replacement home first, I'd like to hear the result of the check before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say that you want to decide on the response after the check rather than take an exchange item home beforehand. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 商品をお預かりして確認する場合は、預り内容と連絡方法をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.translation: If we keep the product for inspection, we'll explain what we're holding and how we'll contact you.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 箱と部品、写真を示して確認をお願いします。預ける場合は、戻す物と連絡予定も控えに書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 箱と部品を示し預ける場合の返却物と連絡予定を控えに残すよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Please check the box, parts, and photo. If I leave them, please also note on the slip which items will be returned and the planned contact arrangements.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Show the box and parts and ask for the items to be returned and contact plans to be recorded if left for inspection. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 承知しました。使用状況を含めて順に確認しますので、お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Certainly. We'll check everything in turn, including the usage circumstances. Please wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。どのようなお米をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Welcome. What kind of rice are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 親族三世帯に同じ米を渡したいです。二キロを二袋、一キロを一袋に分けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 同じ米を二キロ二袋と一キロ一袋へ分けて親族三世帯に渡したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.translation: I'd like to give the same rice to three households of relatives. Could you divide it into two two-kilogram bags and one one-kilogram bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask to divide the same rice into two two-kilogram bags and one one-kilogram bag for three related households. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 合計五キロを三袋ですね。こちらの商品なら、その重さで計量できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Five kilograms in three bags in total, then. We can weigh this product in those quantities.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい、全部同じ商品でお願いします。三世帯とも少しずつ試したいと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 合計五キロで全袋同じ商品を希望すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes, the same product in all bags, please. All three households say they'd like to try a little.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm a total of five kilograms and the same product in every bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 袋にお渡し先のお名前も付けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Would you also like labels with the recipients' names?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 名前は付けなくて大丈夫です。一キロの袋だけわかりやすく印があれば、自分で渡す相手を分けられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 個人名ラベルは不要で一キロ袋の識別印を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.translation: No names are needed. If just the one-kilogram bag has a clear mark, I can distinguish who to give each to myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Decline personal-name labels and request an identifying mark on the one-kilogram bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 一キロの袋に小さい丸印を付けます。重さの表示と商品表示は全ての袋に付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll put a small circle on the one-kilogram bag. All bags will have weight and product labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: それでお願いします。今日私が持ち帰るので、発送の手配は不要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 丸印と重量表示を了承し発送は不要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes, please. I'll take them home myself today, so no shipping arrangements are needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Accept the circle and weight labels and say that shipping isn't needed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 二キロ二袋と一キロ一袋を計量しました。丸印があるのは一キロです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.translation: I've weighed two two-kilogram bags and one one-kilogram bag. The circle marks the one-kilogram bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 重さの表示も確認しました。二キロを二世帯へ、丸印の一キロをもう一世帯へ自分で渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 三袋の重さを確認し自分でそれぞれの世帯へ渡すと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.translation: I've checked the weight labels too. I'll give the two-kilogram bags to two households and the marked one-kilogram bag to the other household myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Check all three bags' weights and explain that you will personally deliver each to its household. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 承知しました。三袋のお会計をいたします。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Certainly. I'll take payment for the three bags. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 会議室を二時から四時まで予約しました。参加者には会議も四時までと伝えましたが、片付けの時間も予約枠に入りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 予約会議室の利用枠に片付け時間も含むか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.translation: I've booked the meeting room from two to four. I told participants the meeting also ends at four, but does the booking include tidying-up time?
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask whether the meeting-room booking slot includes tidying-up time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。四時には部屋を空けていただく利用枠です。机を動かされる予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes, the room must be vacated by four. Are you planning to move any desks?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 三つの机を寄せる予定です。会議が四時に終わってからでは、元へ戻す時間が足りませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 机を三つ寄せるため四時会議終了では原状戻しが間に合わないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.translation: We plan to push three desks together. If the meeting ends at four, there won't be enough time to put them back, will there?
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Explain that three desks will be moved and a four-o'clock meeting finish leaves no time to restore them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 会議を少し早く終えて片付ける計画をご検討ください。元の配置は、この写真で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.translation: Please consider finishing the meeting a little earlier to tidy up. You can check the original layout in this photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: では会議は三時四十分に終えます。参加者へ案内を送り直し、二人に机を戻す係を頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 会議を三時四十分に終え案内訂正と片付け係を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.translation: Then we'll finish the meeting at three forty. I'll resend the information to participants and ask two people to put the desks back.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Set the meeting finish at three forty, correct the announcement, and assign cleanup helpers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 開始前の準備も二時以降になります。受付後に配置を変更してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.translation: Setup before the meeting must also be after two. Please change the layout after checking in.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 早く来た人には受付前で待ってもらい、準備で勝手に部屋へ入らないよう連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 早着者は準備前に部屋へ入らず受付前で待つよう知らせると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll tell early arrivals to wait in front of reception rather than enter the room on their own to set up.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell early arrivals to wait at reception rather than enter the room for setup before allowed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。退室前は机の配置と忘れ物をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes. Before leaving, please check the desk arrangement and any forgotten belongings.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 二時から準備、三時四十分に会議終了、四時までに片付けて退室という予定で参加者へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 二時準備と三時四十分終了と四時退室の予定を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll tell participants: setup from two, meeting ends at three forty, and cleanup and departure by four.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm setup at two, meeting finish at three forty, and departure by four. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 承知しました。そのご予定でご利用ください。お待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-07-001-SHARED-.translation: Understood. Please use the room according to that plan. We look forward to welcoming you.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。ご注文について何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Welcome. Can I help you with your order?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 友人が用事で先に帰ることになりました。さっき頼んだ二品のうち、友人のカレーだけ取り消せるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 急に帰る友人のカレーだけ取消しできるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: My friend has to leave early for something. Of the two dishes we ordered earlier, I'd like to check whether only my friend's curry can be canceled.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can cancel only the curry for your friend who suddenly needs to leave. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 厨房へ確認します。お客様の焼き魚定食は、そのままでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll check with the kitchen. Shall we keep your grilled-fish set meal as ordered?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい、私はここで食べます。定食と自分の飲み物は取り消さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 自分は店内食事を続け定食と飲物を残すよう指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes, I'll eat here. Please don't cancel my set meal or my drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Specify that you will continue eating here and keep your set meal and drink. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: カレーはまだ調理前でしたので取消しできます。お友達の飲み物は、もうお出ししています。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: The curry hasn't been started yet, so it can be canceled. Your friend's drink has already been served.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 友人の飲み物は飲んだので支払います。カレーだけ取消しでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 提供済み友人の飲物は払い調理前カレーのみ取消しを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: My friend drank the drink, so we'll pay for it. Please cancel only the curry.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say that you will pay for your friend's served drink and cancel only the curry not yet prepared. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: その内容に直しました。伝票は定食と飲み物二つです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I've corrected it accordingly. The bill now has the set meal and two drinks.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。友人と分けるつもりの追加料理は、まだ注文していないので新しく頼みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 未注文の追加料理は頼まないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Thank you. We haven't yet ordered the extra dish we planned to share, so I won't order it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say that you won't order the additional dish not yet requested. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 承知しました。お一人で食事を続けるお席としてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Understood. We'll treat the table as one person continuing their meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 伝票の内容を確認しました。友人にカレーは取消しできたと伝え、私は定食を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 訂正伝票を確認し友人へ取消結果を伝えて定食を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I've checked the bill. I'll tell my friend the curry was canceled and wait for my set meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Check the corrected bill, tell your friend the cancellation result, and wait for the set meal. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: かしこまりました。定食をお持ちしますので、どうぞお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Certainly. Please wait while we bring your set meal.

DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。今日の勤務で相談したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. Is there anything you'd like to discuss about today's shift?

DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日、残業の相談があると聞きましたが、通院予約があり五時に退勤する必要があります。先にお伝えしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通院予約のため五時退勤が必要で、残業打診前に相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard there may be a discussion about overtime today, but I have a medical appointment and need to leave at five. May I let you know beforehand?
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you need to leave at five for a medical appointment and want to discuss it before being asked about overtime. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 先に知らせてください。今日は追加の作業を頼む予定でした。どの担当を引き継ぐ必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please let us know early. I planned to ask you to do extra work today. Which duties need handing over?

DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 検品の担当です。五時までに追加分も全部終わるとは、まだ約束できません。
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検品担当で、追加分まで定時に完了とは約束できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm on product inspection. I can't yet promise to finish all the extra items by five.
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you're responsible for inspection and can't promise to finish the extra work by your regular leaving time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、追加分は次の担当に引き継ぐ計画にします。現在の作業の進み具合はどうですか。
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we'll plan to hand the extra items to the next person. How is your current work progressing?

DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今のロットは検品中です。済んだ物と未確認の物を分けて、引継ぎでわかるようにします。
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在ロットは検品中で、確認済みと未確認を分けて引き継ぐと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-06.translation: The current lot is being inspected. I'll separate checked and unchecked items so their status is clear at handover.
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the current lot is under inspection and you will separate checked and unchecked items for handover. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 四時半に班長と引継ぎ内容を確認しましょう。未確認分を合格扱いにしないでください。
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the handover with the team leader at four thirty. Don't treat unchecked items as having passed.

DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 四時半に確認します。時間を合わせるために、検品を省いたり未確認を済みと書いたりはしません。
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 四時半に班長確認を受け、検品省略や未確認の完了扱いをしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check at four thirty. I won't skip inspection or mark unchecked items done just to fit the time.
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will get the team leader's four-thirty check and won't skip inspection or mark unchecked items complete. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 五時に退勤する予定で担当表を調整しました。通院後の勤務については別の日に相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've adjusted the assignment chart for your five-o'clock departure. Let's discuss work after your appointment another day.

DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の五時退勤と四時半の引継ぎを確認しました。残る検品の状態を正確に伝えてから退勤します。
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 五時退勤と四時半引継ぎを確認し、残作業の状態を正確に伝えると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed leaving at five and handover at four thirty. I'll accurately explain the status of remaining inspections before leaving.
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the five-o'clock departure and four-thirty handover and say that you will accurately report the remaining work. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。予定を早めに知らせてくれてありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-IWT-KITAKAMI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for telling us your plans early.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。会場で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at the venue?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から席番号が届きました。私は券を持っていませんが、同じ場所へ行けるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の席番号があるが自分は券なしで同区域へ行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend sent me a seat number. I don't have a ticket myself, but I'd like to check whether I can go to the same area.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have your friend's seat number but no ticket and ask whether you can enter the same area. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その席は有料区域です。ご自身の入場券はまだ購入されていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That seat is in the paid area. You haven't bought your own admission ticket yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 購入していません。友人の席番号がわかれば入れると思ったので、まだ入口の外にいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未購入で、番号だけで入れると思い入口外にいると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't. I thought knowing my friend's seat number would let me enter, so I'm still outside the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you haven't bought a ticket, thought a seat number was enough, and are outside the entrance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 席番号だけではその区域に入れません。無料の観覧区域は、この地図の緑の部分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: A seat number alone doesn't allow entry to that area. The free viewing area is the green section on this map.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私は緑の区域を使います。友人の券を借りて入るのではなく、終わった後に外で合流したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 無料区域を選び、友人の券を借りず終演後に外で合流すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll use the green area. Rather than borrow my friend's ticket to enter, I'd like to meet outside after the event.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the free area and say that you will meet outside after the performance without borrowing your friend's ticket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 有料区域の外の案内所を合流場所にできます。退場口の正面は待たないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can meet at the information desk outside the paid area. Please don't wait directly in front of the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内所を友人に送ります。退場口をふさがず、出て来られるまで外で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内所を友人へ送り、退場口を塞がず外で待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll send my friend the information desk location. I'll wait outside until they come out, without blocking the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will send your friend the information desk location and wait outside without blocking the exit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 友人と同じ席で見る予定ではなく、それぞれの区域で見る形ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you plan to watch in separate areas rather than at your friend's seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、観覧は別々で、終演後は案内所です。券なしで友人の席へ行く計画は取り消します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 観覧区域は別で終演後案内所集合、券なしで席へ行く計画をやめると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, we'll watch separately and meet at the information desk afterward. I'll drop the plan to go to my friend's seat without a ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm separate viewing areas, meeting at the information desk afterward, and abandoning the plan to reach the seat without a ticket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。区域を確認してご利用ください。花火をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the areas as you use them. Enjoy the fireworks.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。荷物の移動で何を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. What would you like to check about moving the goods?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 無線で右の棚と言われましたが、私と指示した方の向きが違います。動かす前に棚番号を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 無線の右棚指示で向きが違うため運搬前に棚番号を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The radio instruction said the right-hand shelf, but I'm facing a different direction from the person giving instructions. I'd like to check the shelf number before moving anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the shelf number before transport because you face a different direction from the person saying 'right shelf' over the radio. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: あなたはいま、どちらを向いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which way are you facing now?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口へ向いています。担当の方は入口から奥を見ていたので、左右が逆になっていると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分は入口向き、指示者は奥向きで左右が逆だと思うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Toward the entrance. The person in charge was looking inward from the entrance, so I think our left and right are reversed.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you face the entrance and the instructor faces inward, so your left and right appear reversed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 指示した場所は、入口から奥を見て右の棚、棚番号Ｒ三です。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The instructed location is the shelf on the right when looking inward from the entrance, shelf R3.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口から見た右、Ｒ三ですね。自分の今の右へ置くのではないと確認できました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口から見た右のＲ三と復唱し、自分の今の右ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Right when seen from the entrance, R3. I've confirmed it isn't my current right-hand side.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Repeat R3 on the right when viewed from the entrance and confirm it isn't your present right. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。棚番号と荷札の指定を照合してください。この荷物にはＲ三とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct. Match the shelf number with the luggage tag. This item says R3.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷札もＲ三です。荷物はまだ動かしていないので、置き間違えた物の移し替えではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷札Ｒ三を照合し、まだ未運搬で誤配置の移替えではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The tag also says R3. I haven't moved it yet, so this isn't relocating something I put in the wrong place.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Match tag R3 and say that it hasn't been transported yet, rather than being moved from an incorrect location. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 指定の歩行経路と運搬方法でお進みください。棚の前で番号も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the designated walking route and transport method. Check the number at the shelf too.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: Ｒ三へ運び、棚前の表示を見ます。無線で左右だけがわからない時は、向きと番号を聞き返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: Ｒ三で表示を確認し、不明な左右指示は向きと番号で聞き返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take it to R3 and check the sign in front. When a radio instruction about left or right is unclear, I'll ask again about direction and number.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the R3 sign and clarify unclear left/right instructions using orientation and numbers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。動かす前の確認をありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. Thank you for checking before moving it.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。始める前にお伝えになりたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything you'd like to tell us before starting?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族の迎えが三時に来ます。いつもの終了より早いので、今日の進め方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 迎え三時が通常終了より早いため、開始前に進め方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family will pick me up at three. That's earlier than the usual finish, so I'd like to discuss today's plan.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the plan before starting because a three-o'clock pickup is earlier than the usual finish. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いまの予定は三時半までですね。家族に待ってもらうことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The current plan runs until three thirty. Could your family wait?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族も別の用事があり、三時には出発したいそうです。始めてから黙って帰るのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族は三時出発が必要で、途中に黙って帰るのを避けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They have another commitment and want to leave at three. I want to avoid starting and then leaving without saying anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your family needs to leave at three and you don't want to depart silently midway. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ時間の希望を伝えます。いつもの運動を自分で削って済ませることはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the responsible staff your time preference. Please don't shorten your usual exercises yourself to finish them.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で回数や内容を変えません。短い時間で何を行うか、担当の説明を先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 運動内容回数を自分で削らず、担当の説明を先に希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't change the repetitions or content myself. I'd first like to hear the staff's explanation of what to do in the shorter time.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you won't reduce exercise content or repetitions yourself and want the staff's explanation first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当と確認しました。今日は開始前の状態確認と説明を中心にし、次回の予約を相談する案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've checked with the staff. Today's guidance is to focus on checking your condition before starting and giving explanations, then discuss the next appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は状態確認と説明なんですね。いつもの全部を終えたという記録にはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日は状態確認と説明中心と理解し、全メニュー完了扱いはしないよう伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: So today is mainly a condition check and explanations. Please don't record that I've completed the full usual program.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that you understand today's focus is checks and explanations and ask not to mark the whole program complete. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その内容で担当が記録します。家族にも、三時までの予定を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will record that content. Please also confirm the plan through three o'clock with your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族へ三時出発と伝えました。今日は確認と説明を受け、次回の予約を担当と相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族へ出発時刻を伝え、今日は確認説明と次回予約相談を行うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've told my family we'll leave at three. Today I'll receive the checks and explanations and discuss the next appointment with the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you told your family the departure time and will receive checks and explanations and discuss your next appointment today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご希望を事前に伝えていただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for telling us your wishes beforehand.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お部屋の費用で何を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What would you like to check about the housing costs?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この見積りは駐車場も入っていますが、車を持っていません。駐車場なしの金額を聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車がなく、駐車場なしの見積りを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This estimate includes parking, but I don't have a car. Could you tell me the amount without parking?
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have no car and want an estimate without parking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この物件は駐車場を別に選べます。月額欄の三千円が駐車場です。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Parking is optional with this property. The three thousand yen in the monthly field is the parking fee.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家賃に含まれる必須のものだと思っていました。今回は駐車場を選ばない形にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駐車場を必須と誤解したが今回は選ばないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was a compulsory part of the rent. This time I'd like to choose no parking.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook parking for compulsory and won't choose it this time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 月額の駐車場分を外します。初期費用にも駐車場の契約分があるので、そちらも直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll remove the monthly parking charge. The initial costs also include a parking-contract charge, so I'll correct those too.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 月額だけでなく初期費用にもあるんですね。二つの合計を別々に見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 月額と初期費用の駐車場分を別々に訂正して見せてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it's in the initial costs as well as the monthly amount. Please show me the two totals separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to see the corrected monthly and initial parking-related costs separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訂正後の月額と初期費用はこちらです。部屋自体の家賃と契約条件は、この見積りでは変更していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here are the corrected monthly and initial totals. This estimate hasn't changed the room's rent or contract conditions themselves.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 駐車場分だけを外したと理解しました。部屋の初期費用まで全部なくなるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 駐車場分だけの除外で部屋初期費用全消失ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand that only the parking portion was removed. I won't assume all the room's initial costs disappear too.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that only parking is excluded, not all initial costs for the room. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。まだ申込みを受け付けたわけではないので、持ち帰ってご検討いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. We haven't accepted an application yet, so you can take it home and consider it.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 訂正した見積りを持ち帰ります。駐車場なしの月額と初期費用を比べて、部屋の申込みを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正見積りを持帰り、月額初期費用を検討して申込みを決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the corrected estimate home. I'll consider the monthly and initial costs without parking and decide whether to apply for the room.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take the corrected estimate home and decide on an application after considering monthly and initial costs. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つの合計を確認してご検討ください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the two totals as you consider it. Thank you for consulting us.
